verses.pali: Yo ca dhamme dhammasaññī, yo ca adhamme adhammasaññī.
verses.english: One who perceives the teaching as the teaching, and one who perceives what is not the teaching as not the teaching.

verses.pali: Imesaṁ kho, bhikkhave, dvinnaṁ āsavā na vaḍḍhantī”ti.
verses.english: These are the two whose defilements don’t grow.”
